title: fix(docs): repair read examples and check them in PRs
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Fixed generated API request examples so optional query parameters without usable values are omitted instead of appearing as placeholders such as `seed=:seed` or `limit=:limit`. Examples keep up to two optional query parameters with values and include required parameters regardless of their position; the `/media` gallery example supplies `tag=my-gallery`. Path parameters now prefer schema examples, then route-specific fallback IDs, rather than reusing an unrelated API-key ID. Request-example checks now cover GET and HEAD as well as write methods, and reject unresolved placeholders in URL paths and query values during PR validation.
